description: Biological and Embedding Validation Protocol Freeze

frozen_parameters.D_tax_definition: Number of hierarchical boundaries at which lineages diverge (0 to 6). 0 = exact species match, 6 = mismatch at Phylum level.
frozen_parameters.missing_taxonomy_handling: Exclude from distance calculation at that rank. 'uncultured', 'unclassified', 'sp.', and empty/null strings do not trigger a mismatch; the sequences are considered indistinguishable at that level unless explicitly proven different.

pair_sampling_algorithm.primary: balanced (equal pairs across all valid D_tax levels)
pair_sampling_algorithm.secondary: natural (sampled according to naturally occurring test-set frequency)

nn_purity.self_match_exclusion_rule: Strictly exclude query sequence from its own neighbors. NN_k(x) \u2286 D \\ {x}
nn_purity.reference_population: Full Phase 6 Open-Set test pool for the specific rank/seed configuration
